evidence.scope: Absence of matches for this ruleset only. Absence of a signal is not evidence of absence: an ORM misuse or dynamic identifier the regex does not know stays invisible.

actions.reason: Scanner check cost.budget_caps is tier MANUAL: no static signal exists for provider dashboard settings. Emitted as an explicit to-do so it cannot be silently skipped.

deadline.rationale: Uncapped paid providers plus public traffic is how surprise bills happen.

actions.success_evidence: Owner-provided dashboard evidence per provider; self-certification without evidence is not enough.
